subject: Producing a single commen legend in a grid layout

messages.author: 4778dcdaf4dfb3fb
messages.subject: Producing a single commen legend in a grid layout
parts:
Hello ggplotians

I'm producing a series of four boxplots that each display a different response variable from a three treatment longitudinal study. Each boxplot has an identical legend. How can I produce a single, appropriately-sized legend off to the right side?

Here are some mock data:

library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())

datums<-data.frame(var1=runif(60,4,6),var2=runif(60,25,30),var3=runif(60,0,1),var4=runif(60,10,15),var.time=rep(1:3,times=20),var.treatment=rep(c('a','b','c'),each=20))
datums$var.time<-as.factor(datums$var.time)

#And what I've done so far:

p<-ggplot(datums,aes(x=var.time,fill=var.treatment))+scale_fill_manual('Treatment',value=c('white','light grey','dark grey'))+xlab('')

p1<-p+geom_boxplot(data=datums,aes(y=var1))+scale_x_discrete(breaks=c(1,2,3),labels=c('','',''))
p2<-p+geom_boxplot(data=datums,aes(y=var2))+scale_x_discrete(breaks=c(1,2,3),labels=c('','',''))
p3<-p+geom_boxplot(data=datums,aes(y=var3))+scale_x_discrete(breaks=c(1,2,3),labels=c('Time 1','Time 2','Time 3'))
p4<-p+geom_boxplot(data=datums,aes(y=var4))+scale_x_discrete(breaks=c(1,2,3),labels=c('Time 1','Time 2','Time 3'))



quartz('test panel',width=8,height=8)
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout=grid.layout(2,2)))

vplayout<-function(x,y) viewport(layout.pos.row=x,layout.pos.col=y)

print(p1,vp=vplayout(1,1))
print(p2,vp=vplayout(1,2))
print(p3,vp=vplayout(2,1))
print(p4,vp=vplayout(2,2))



It seems like this should be a pretty trivial thing, but Hadley has said that control of legends is limited. I've searched the archives here, but the most relevant discussions are several years old. Have there been any changes that might apply in this situation? I sincerely appreciate any advice.

messages.subject: RE: Producing a single commen legend in a grid layout
parts:
Dear Justin,
 
Melt your data.frame and then use facet_wrap
 

Molten <- melt(datums, id.vars = c("var.time", "var.treatment"))

ggplot(Molten, aes(x = var.time, fill = var.treatment, y = value)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~variable, scale = "free_y")

Best regards,

 

Thierry
